categories.name: Text and image to 3D
categories.intro: Prompt or photo in, textured mesh out. Good for concepts, games, visualisation and hobby printing. Not dimensioned engineering geometry.

categories.name: Text and sketch to CAD
categories.intro: Tools that aim for real, measurable solids you can edit and export as STEP. Still early: useful for concepts and simple parts.

categories.name: Scanning and scan to CAD
categories.intro: Capture real objects with a phone or scanner, then turn the mesh into something an engineer can work with.

categories.name: CAM and machining
categories.intro: AI that recognises features, picks tools and drafts toolpaths. Every one of these keeps a programmer in the loop.

categories.name: Simulation and physics AI
categories.intro: Surrogate models trained on CFD and FEA results that predict performance in seconds instead of hours.

tools.name: Tripo AI
tools.what: Text and image to 3D model generator, often ranked first in 2026 comparisons for detail and print-ready output.

tools.name: Meshy
tools.what: Self-serve 3D generator with PBR textures, rigging, low-poly tools and printing workflows.

tools.name: Hyper3D Rodin
tools.what: High-fidelity native 3D generation, top of several hands-on tests this year.

tools.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D
tools.what: Open-weight 3D generation model, widely named the best free option in 2026.

tools.name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2
tools.what: Research model from Microsoft for structured 3D generation; one to watch rather than a finished product.

tools.name: Kaedim
tools.what: AI generation combined with human quality checks before delivery.

tools.name: Zoo
tools.what: CAD platform with text-to-CAD that produces editable B-rep solids instead of meshes.

tools.name: Adam
tools.what: Text to 3D with part editing and parameters; quick parametric concept models.

tools.name: Autodesk Fusion AI features
tools.what: AI assistance built into Fusion, named alongside Zoo as the most useful text-to-CAD option for engineers.

tools.name: Luxxo CAD
tools.what: Turns text descriptions and sketches into 3D CAD models; free web app and Android app.
tools.bestFor: Trying text and sketch to CAD for free

tools.name: SolidCraft
tools.what: Open-source parametric CAD with a feature timeline, assemblies and an MCP server so AI agents can model with the same commands a person uses.
tools.bestFor: Trying an AI agent on a real parametric kernel

tools.name: Backflip AI
tools.what: Converts 3D scans and STL meshes into parametric CAD with a feature tree; web app, Fusion add-in and SOLIDWORKS plugin.
tools.bestFor: Reverse engineering worn or legacy parts

tools.name: KIRI Engine
tools.what: Photo and LiDAR scanning with Gaussian splatting; one of the few scan apps on both iOS and Android.

tools.name: Scaniverse
tools.what: Free, unlimited Gaussian splatting processed on the phone itself.

tools.name: Polycam
tools.what: Photogrammetry, LiDAR and Gaussian splatting in one app, updated frequently.

tools.name: CloudNC CAM Assist
tools.what: Generates machining strategies for 3 and 3+2 axis parts; used by over 1,000 shops, works in Fusion, Mastercam, NX and GibbsCAM.

tools.name: Siemens NX X Manufacturing Copilot
tools.what: Chat assistant inside NX CAM that suggests operations, tools and parameters for selected features.

tools.name: Manukai
tools.what: CAM copilot that learns from a shop's past programs to automate recurring tasks and standardise tooling.
tools.bestFor: Shops with a large program history

tools.name: Limitless Labs CAM Agent
tools.what: Agent that takes a CAD file, identifies features, picks tools, sequences operations and drafts a CNC program.
tools.bestFor: Watching where CAM automation is heading

tools.name: PhysicsX
tools.what: Deep-learning surrogates trained on CFD and FEA that return near-instant predictions, at up to 100,000 simulations a day.

tools.name: Neural Concept
tools.what: Physics AI used in automotive design, including at Jaguar Land Rover.

tools.name: Simcenter PhysicsAI
tools.what: No-code surrogate models that predict KPIs directly on mesh or CAD, trained on your own simulation history.

tools.name: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo
tools.what: Open-source framework for building physics-ML surrogate models.
